_comment: Tier-2 for fourc::low_mach#1 and a FALSIFICATION of its Signal. The rule (VELOCITYFIELD must be Navier_Stokes) holds; the quoted warning 'VELOCITYFIELD=zero with PHYSICAL_TYPE=Loma is inconsistent' does not exist in 4C. FourC::loma_dyn switches on VELOCITYFIELD: Navier_Stokes takes the coupled branch that clones the scatra discretisation from the fluid, while zero and function both take a scatra-only branch that requires a hand-written TRANSPORT ELEMENTS section and throws 'No elements in input section ---TRANSPORT ELEMENTS!' from 4C_loma_dyn.cpp when it is absent. On the upstream deck loma_2d_heated_chan_30x100 the fluid field is simply never built, so the 'temperature evolves as in a stagnant medium' symptom cannot be observed either. Verified by execution 2026-08-06 against 4C 2026.2.0-dev (git 89519cf).
